chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn 'Uthman, from Bukayr ibn A'yan, who said:
I said to him: A man doubts after he has performed wudu (ablution). He said: “When he performs wudu (ablution), he is more mindful than he is when he doubts.”

key_terms.بَعْدَ: after the completion of the act

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone doubts his wudu (ablution) after finishing it?
ai.summary: This hadith states that doubt arising after completing wudu (ablution) is not given weight. Its significance is in establishing a legal principle in ritual purity: the state during the act, when one is attentive, is relied upon over later misgiving.
